Package io.mdudel.zenoh.purejava.connection

Class ZenohConnection

java.lang.Object
io.mdudel.zenoh.purejava.connection.ZenohConnection
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class ZenohConnection extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Combined publish/subscribe facade backed by one Zenoh session and one transport connection. This package is additive; the original publisher and subscriber facades are intentionally unchanged.
